title: Fix regressed balances.settlements references (should be pairwise)
declaredInterface: No interface change - internal fix only, reading balances.pairwise instead of the nonexistent balances.settlements.
assumptions: A teammate's recent commit (adding MemberBalancesSummary.jsx and reworking BalancesView.jsx tabs) was based on an older copy of BalancesView.jsx and reintroduced `balances.settlements`, which the backend stopped returning earlier this session (renamed to `pairwise`). This silently breaks the Settle Up tab and per-member outgoing/incoming lists (always empty). Fixing field references only, not touching the new summary UI/UX.
